text:
peter-sec: FYI we received a report from a partner about auto-accepting federated metadata that preserves an old trust chain. Potential MITM of federation if a compromised metadata URL was previously accepted. Not public.

lucy-sre: Which deployments are affected?

peter-sec: Private installs with `federation.auto_accept=true` and older Dedicated control plane versions that ran metadata import v1. The hosted service is not affected. Inventory shows 6 Private + 4 Dedicated.

deploy-bot: Created SEC-9901 and attached build: https://ci.redwood-internal/job/SEC-9901.

lucy-sre: Immediate mitigation: flip `federation.auto_accept=false` and remove any trust entries created automatically in the last 60 days. We'll push a patch to the importer lib (v4.0.1-patch).

peter-sec: Customer comms: short blurb + offer assisted rotation of federation certs. Also need legal-approved language for regulated customers.

amy-cs: I'll draft the notice and include an opt-in for us to perform the rotation.

rachel-legal: Approving template but add escalation contact and confirmation that we observed no credential exfiltration so far.

lucy-sre: Quick commands for Private (helm): helm upgrade --set federation.autoAccept=false redwood-private ./chart

lucy-sre: And for Dedicated control-plane: kubectl -n redwood-system patch configmap federation-config -p '{"data":{"auto_accept":"false"}}'

peter-sec: Timeline: disable now (T+1h), ship patched importer in 12h, rollout to Dedicated canary 2h after patch, full rollout 24-36h. Cert rotation window 72h for affected customers.

amy-cs: Noted, starting customer outreach. Tag me if a customer needs immediate hands-on help.

peter-sec: Thanks team. We'll run a telemetry query for unexpected federation fetches in the last 90 days and post an internal summary once done.
